_comment: Historical BUG-235 calibration record. The 2026-10-09 visual-label correction invalidates every prior offset below. No active calibration is supplied: raw scoring with zero correction is not a new calibration. Values and reasons remain only as repair provenance; see tests/fixtures/audio_labels/README.md.
method: Historical median(pred_time - nearest_truth_time) over raw ADTOF kicks (default thresholds) vs the then-current mix_time_s truth, matched within ±0.3s.
